race.comment: The feature race on the card, the $150,000 Cairns Cup. ZOOLOGY (1) hasn't been too far away in recent Cups outings and looks to be building up to another victory. Has saluted on all going and will be at peak fitness for this contest. Best figures measure up nicely. JOURNALISM (3) has been racing very consistently of late and only needs some luck from the sticky draw to be featuring in the finish. SMART LEGEND (2) returned to the winners' stall at the latest start and Wiggins stays on top. In the mix. SIGIRIYA ROCK (8) has just run into one better at the past couple of efforts and has solid top-three prospects. THAT'S MOLLY (10) next best.
